name: orbit
description: Open-source workspace for legal studios to coordinate clients, projects, cases, tasks, events, and activity.

scripts.api:check: bun run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/web/src/lib/api/generated
scripts.install:apps: bun install --cwd apps/web --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd apps/api --frozen-lockfile
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run --cwd apps/api test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck
scripts.build: bun run help:generate && bun run --cwd apps/web --env-file=.env build && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.build-api: bun run help:generate && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run help:check
